items.name: Filter.Eventually.exists
items.type: {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {f : Filter α} [f.NeBot] (hp : ∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) : ∃ x, p x

items.name: Filter.frequently_iff_forall_eventually_exists_and

items.name: Filter.Eventually.choice

items.name: Filter.Eventually.exists_mem

items.name: Filter.eventually_iff_exists_mem
items.type: {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {f : Filter α} : (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) ↔ ∃ v ∈ f, ∀ y ∈ v, p y

items.name: Filter.skolem
